start.title: [TODO:it] A Question of Love
start.text:
[TODO:it] Jesus sits on the hill and asks,
"What man, having a hundred sheep...?"

choices.text: [TODO:it] Turn away from the small story

turn_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Stay a While
turn_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He tells it only for hearts like yours.
Come back and hear.

flock.title: [TODO:it] The Hundred
flock.text:
[TODO:it] A shepherd walks among his sheep,
knowing each one by name.

count_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Each One Matters
count_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] No sheep is worth less than another.
Not in his eyes.

lost.title: [TODO:it] One Wanders
lost.text:
[TODO:it] A small lamb slips beyond the rocks,
alone in the gathering dusk.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Say it deserves to be lost
[TODO:it] Hope the wolves find it first

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Mercy First
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He does not weigh the lamb's fault.
He only wants it home.

cruel_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Love Goes After
cruel_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Heaven does not abandon the small.
It runs to find them.

leave.title: [TODO:it] Leaving the Ninety-Nine
leave.text:
[TODO:it] He sets the flock by a sheltered rock,
and turns toward the dark hills.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Tell him the one is not worth it
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] To him, every one is worth it.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Walk with him into the dusk

worth_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Worth of One
worth_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He would leave ninety-nine for you.
That is how love counts.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Walk with him into the dusk

search.title: [TODO:it] Through the Valley
search.text:
[TODO:it] Through mist and stone he calls its name,
lantern raised against the night.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Give up when the path is hard
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] He will not give up on you.

giveup_consequence.title: [TODO:it] He Keeps Going
giveup_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Tired feet do not turn him back.
Love is stubborn that way.

found.title: [TODO:it] Found
found.text:
[TODO:it] At dawn he kneels in a quiet ravine,
and lifts the trembling lamb.

scold_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Only Kindness
scold_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Not one harsh word leaves his mouth.
Only kindness, only joy.

carry.title: [TODO:it] On His Shoulders
carry.text:
[TODO:it] He lays the lamb across his shoulders,
and walks the long road home.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Ask him to set it down to walk

walk_consequence.title: [TODO:it] He Carries You
walk_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The lost are too tired to walk alone.
Let him carry.

celebration.title: [TODO:it] Rejoice With Me
celebration.text:
[TODO:it] He calls his friends, eyes shining,
"Rejoice! I have found my lost one."

envy_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Joy for Each
envy_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Heaven rejoices over every one.
Every one means you.

ending.title: [TODO:it] Heaven's Joy
ending.text:
[TODO:it] Jesus smiles at you in the warm light.
"So heaven rejoices over one."
